_about: Data for the samosa station v2 (design system §15), the combined station js/cook/stations/samosa.js: fill the pastry strip from the shelf's filling heaps (a spoonful per tap; v3, 29 Sept: top-down heaps, no bowls), fold it by swiping (the first fold hides the filling, then fixed fold pictures), make as many as they asked for, then fry them in the karahi on the kitchen kit's wide hob and lift each onto the paper-lined plate when golden. Serve and taste (§14a). The fill's decoys are data.mechanics.fill, the fold's swipe data.mechanics.fold, the fry's speed and golden band data.mechanics.fry (by level). `phases`: one English line per job (placeholders, like every station goal) and the phase button's label.

station.name: Samosa
station.goal: Fill the pastry with what they said, fold it, make as many as they asked for, then fry them golden.

phases.fill: Tap the fillings: one spoon each tap, as many spoons as they said. Then tap the tick.
phases.fold: Swipe where it glows to fold the samosa. Make as many as they asked for, then tap "fry them".
phases.fry: Turn on the hob, put the samosas in, and lift each one out when it's golden.
